title: Bracket validation with a stack
summary: Push opening brackets and require every closing bracket to match the most recent opener. Other characters are ignored.
code: guard stack.popLast() == expected else { return false }
triggers: nested opening and closing delimiters must match in reverse order
properly nested delimiters where the latest opener must close first
prompts: Validate nested brackets in text while ignoring nonbracket characters.
A formula contains round, square and curly brackets. Reject a closer that does not match the most recent unmatched opener.
invariant: The stack contains unmatched opening brackets in encounter order.
mantra: Push openers; match closers; finish empty.
pitfalls: Equal counts alone do not prove valid nesting.
This is bracket matching, not a source-code parser; quotes and comments receive no special handling.

anchors.name: Valid Parentheses
anchors.trick: A stack checks nesting order as well as delimiter types.
